page.layout: One text column with running head and page number at top. Main text runs from top to bottom, with a paragraph continuing from the previous page and one new paragraph beginning mid-page. Catchword "Ac" at lower right.

main_text.p: secundum illa verba Moses: Et fuit die tertia, cum factum esset mane, facta sunt tonitrua, & fulgura, & nubes densissima super montem, & clangor buccinae intè-tisimus: expauitq; universus populus, qui erat in castris. Et eduxit Mose popu-lum in occursum Dei è castris: qui stete-runt in inferiore parte montis. Mons autem Sinai fumabat totus, eo quòd defcé-diffet super eum Iehouah in igne: afcen-debatq; fumus eius sicut fumus fornacis, & commotus est universus mons vehementer. Erat praeterea clangor buccinae procedes, & invalescebat valde: Mo-se loquebatur, & Deus ei respondebat in voce. Exod.19.16.17.18, &c.

Quàm fuerit autem grauis populo Israelitico tum sonus ille terribilis, tum lucis fulgor, testatur Moses capite sequenti, versu 18. Omnis autem populus videbant tonitrua & lampades, & clangorem buccinae, & motem fumantem: vidit-in-quam populus, & commoti sunt, steterunt-que procul. 19. Atque dixerunt Mosi: Loquere tu nobiscum, & obsequemur: & ne loquatur nobiscum Deus, ne mo-riamur.

page.notes: Show-through and faint marks at the lower left and in the lower margin left out. Long s normalised as plain s. Abbreviations kept as printed (q;). Two words with a printed line-end hyphen are kept with the hyphen. The printed word "eft" is read as "est", and "ualde" with u/v normalised per the rules. Some letters in the top line are slightly blurred but legible. Tokens like "vidit-in-quam" reflect a line-end break inside the printed word and may need checking.
